description: §19.10.6 compile-time rejection — `transactions="concurrent"` asks for one pool connection per transaction, but the program's database is a SQLite file: one connection, so its transactions always run one at a time. The opt-in is refused with E-SQL-010 rather than silently ignored.
rationale: §19.10.6 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S449 item C, opt-in (b)): `transactions="concurrent"` on a SQLite database SHALL be a compile error (E-SQL-010). Resolution: remove the attribute, or use a `postgres://` / `mysql://` database.
